answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 51 POA per identity, released only after 11 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 420 fakes must lock 21420 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. A lagoon that can be verified, a thread that can be measured, and a velvet that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
